muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /feed sse(Feed(ctx))" -}}{{- if .Err -}}err:{{- .Err -}}{{- else -}}ok:{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"errors"
	"html/template"
	"iter"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Feed yields a good value then a per-item error; the define body branches on
// .Err so both render as events.
func (Server) Feed(ctx context.Context) iter.Seq2[string, error] {
	return func(yield func(string, error) bool) {
		if !yield("one", nil) {
			return
		}
		yield("", errors.New("boom"))
	}
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/feed", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	if want := "data: ok:one\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want the ok event %q", body, want)
	}
	if want := "data: err:boom\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want the error event %q", body, want)
	}
}
